gloss: remains; ashes of the deceased; cremated bones

definitions.gloss: remains; ashes of the deceased; cremated bones
definitions.explanation: The bones and ashes remaining after cremation, or the skeletal remains of a deceased person. In Japan, where cremation is nearly universal, this word most often refers to the cremated remains.

examples.japanese: {遺骨|いこつ}をお{墓|はか}に{納|おさ}める。
examples.english: To inter the remains in a grave.

examples.japanese: {遺骨|いこつ}は{骨壺|こつつぼ}に{入|い}れて{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: The remains were placed in an urn and brought home.

examples.japanese: {戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}の{遺骨|いこつ}{収集|しゅうしゅう}が{今|いま}も{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The collection of war dead remains continues to this day.

notes: In Japan, after cremation ({火葬|かそう}), family members pick up the {遺骨|いこつ} with chopsticks ({箸|はし}) in a ceremony called {骨上|こつあ}げ or {拾骨|しゅうこつ}, placing them in a {骨壺|こつつぼ} (urn). Common collocations: {遺骨|いこつ}を{拾|ひろ}う (to pick up remains), {遺骨|いこつ}を{納|おさ}める (to inter remains), {遺骨|いこつ}{収集|しゅうしゅう} (collection of remains). Related terms: {遺灰|いはい} (ashes), {遺体|いたい} (corpse, body).
